tools.name: quantum_status
tools.description: What this server runs: algorithm, qubit limit, quantum backends, signing keys, and anchoring.

tools.name: quantum_pricing
tools.description:
Which tools are paid, their price per call, how to pay (x402: USDC on Base, or the PRIVI token), and the
payout wallet ($0.001). Failed calls are never charged.

tools.name: quantum_problems
tools.description: The ready-made problems quantum_optimize accepts and the data each one needs, with an example.

tools.name: quantum_optimize
tools.description:
Solve a factory decision with the Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm. Returns the decision in
plain terms, how close it is to the proven optimum, and a post-quantum signed attestation (Ed25519 +
ML-DSA-87) that is anchored on chain (Base). Paid per call via x402 when payments are on (see qua

tools.name: quantum_verify
tools.description: Check both post-quantum signatures, the body hash, and the on-chain anchor of a result. Paid per call via x402 when payments are on (see quantum_pricing).

tools.name: pqc_scan_code
tools.description:
Find RSA, elliptic-curve, Diffie-Hellman, DSA, weak hashes and 128-bit ciphers that quantum
computers break or weaken; returns a 0-100 readiness score and a fix per finding. Nothing is stored.

tools.name: pqc_readiness_package
tools.description:
Build a signed post-quantum readiness package: prioritized migration list with the federal deadline for
each asset (EO 14409, OMB M-26-15, NIST IR 8547 draft, CNSA 2.0), the nine M-26-15 plan elements marked as
evidence or gaps, and a CycloneDX 1.6 CBOM. Signed with ML-DSA-87, anchored on chain, pub

tools.name: pqc_endpoint_check
tools.description:
Test live public sites and services for TLS 1.3 and hybrid post-quantum key exchange (X25519MLKEM768,
FIPS 203), the protection against 'harvest now, decrypt later'. Sends two TLS hellos per endpoint and no data.
Returns a status and fix per endpoint plus CBOM-ready assets for pqc_readiness_package.

tools.name: pqc_federal_deadlines
tools.description:
The U.S. federal post-quantum timeline (EO 14409, OMB M-26-15, NIST IR 8547 draft, NSA CNSA 2.0), the
approved replacement algorithms, and links to the sources. Paid per call via x402 when payments are on (see quantum_pricing).

tools.name: quantum_advantage_receipt
tools.description:
Race the quantum answer against classical baselines (exhaustive search = proven optimum, and simulated
annealing) on the same problem and seal the result as a signed, chain-anchored Quantum Advantage Receipt:
answer quality and time for each side and a verdict (quantum_won / classical_won / tie), pu

tools.name: quantum_backends
tools.description:
Every quantum backend this server can route to (local simulator, IonQ, IBM Quantum, Amazon Braket),
whether it is usable now, its estimated price, measured turnaround, and the hardware budget. Paid per call via x402 when payments are on (see quantum_pricing).

tools.name: quantum_run_hardware
tools.description:
Train the CVaR-QAOA circuit, route it to a quantum backend (IonQ, IBM Quantum, Amazon Braket or this
server's simulator) by price or speed, and return a job id. When the run finishes, the answer is sealed with a
post-quantum signed attestation and a Quantum Advantage Receipt against classical baseli

tools.name: quantum_hardware_job
tools.description:
Status of a quantum hardware job; once done, the decision, measurement statistics, the signed attestation and
the Quantum Advantage Receipt. Paid per call via x402 when payments are on (see quantum_pricing).

tools.name: quantum_mandate_request
tools.description:
Draft a Quantum Mandate: the spending terms under which this agent may run paid quantum hardware jobs.
Returns a sign_url for the person who approved the agent; they sign the exact terms with their passkey. Paid per call via x402 when payments are on (see quantum_pricing).

tools.name: quantum_mandate_status
tools.description:
A Quantum Mandate's terms, status (draft, active, expired, revoked), spend, remaining budget and every
charge and refund. Paid per call via x402 when payments are on (see quantum_pricing).

tools.name: quantum_mandate_check
tools.description:
Would this paid run be allowed under the mandate? Picks the backend the router would use, estimates the
price and checks it against every term without spending anything. Paid per call via x402 when payments are on (see quantum_pricing).

tools.name: quantum_mandate_revoke
tools.description:
The agent gives up its own mandate (the person can also revoke on the mandate page with their passkey).
The revocation is signed and anchored. Paid per call via x402 when payments are on; the person who signed it can also revoke it on the mandate web page with their passkey.

tools.name: quantum_run_circuit
tools.description:
Bring your own quantum circuit. Paste the OpenQASM that Qiskit writes and Privi runs it on IBM Quantum, IonQ,
Amazon Braket or its own simulator, picked by price or speed, then seals the measurement counts with a
post-quantum signature anchored on chain. Standard Qiskit gates are rewritten exactly i

tools.name: pqc_crypto_inventory
tools.description:
Point Privi at a company's domains and GitHub repositories and get one cryptographic bill of materials: every
algorithm quantum computers will break, where it is, a prioritized migration plan with dates, a CycloneDX 1.6
CBOM and a public report page, signed with ML-DSA-87 and anchored on chain. Repo

tools.name: vault_keygen
tools.description:
Create a hybrid X25519 + ML-KEM (FIPS 203) key pair for Privi Vault. The private key is returned once and not
stored here; for the strongest setup generate it locally with `python -m privi_quantum.vault keygen`. Paid per call via x402 when payments are on (see quantum_pricing).

tools.name: vault_seal
tools.description:
Re-wrap long-lived sensitive data under hybrid post-quantum encryption (X25519 + ML-KEM, AES-256-GCM) so data
recorded today can't be decrypted by a future quantum computer. Returns the envelope and a signed protection
receipt anchored on chain. Plaintext is not stored. Paid per call via x402 when p

tools.name: vault_open
tools.description:
Decrypt a Privi Vault envelope. Nothing is stored; for sensitive data prefer opening locally with
`python -m privi_quantum.vault open`. Paid per call via x402 when payments are on (see quantum_pricing).

tools.name: vault_receipt
tools.description:
Get a signed, chain-anchored protection receipt proving data was under hybrid post-quantum encryption by a
given time, for envelopes sealed with the local Privi Vault tool. Paid per call via x402 when payments are on (see quantum_pricing).

tools.name: privilege_directory
tools.description:
Every quantum realm Privi can run a job on (engines on this server and other Privi Quantum nodes),
ranked by expected time to the proven optimum, with latency, optimum rate, wins and status. Paid per call via x402 when payments are on (see quantum_pricing).

tools.name: privilege_benchmark
tools.description:
Run the standard 8-qubit benchmark on every active realm at once and update Privilege's speed
rankings. At most once every 2 minutes for everyone. Requires a Privi pass. Paid per call via x402 when payments are on (see quantum_pricing).

tools.name: dreamweaver_run
tools.description:
Run one quantum optimization on several realms at once and return the winning answer, every realm's
timing, and a post-quantum signed attestation (Ed25519 + ML-DSA-87) anchored on chain. Paid per call via x402 when payments are on (see quantum_pricing).

tools.name: dreamscape_open
tools.description:
Open a private Dream Scape: your own quantum environment that keeps every job and result. Returns
scape_id and scape_key (shown once; keep it). Paid per call via x402 when payments are on (see quantum_pricing).

tools.name: dreamscape_submit
tools.description: Run a quantum job in your Dream Scape through Dream Weaver and keep the result there. Paid per call via x402 when payments are on (see quantum_pricing).

tools.name: dreamscape_jobs
tools.description: Your Dream Scape's recent jobs, or one job with its full result. Paid per call via x402 when payments are on (see quantum_pricing).

tools.name: accelerator_info
tools.description:
The program that upgrades an AI agent into a certified quantum agent: the four steps (Q1-Q4), the
levels, how to make an ML-DSA key in five lines, and the free directory checks. Paid per call via x402 when payments are on (see quantum_pricing).

tools.name: qagent_enroll
tools.description:
Join the Quantum Agent Accelerator. Returns agent_id and agent_token (shown once; keep it) and your
upgrade plan. Your public key goes in the directory so other agents can verify what you sign. Paid per call via x402 when payments are on (see quantum_pricing).

tools.name: qagent_scan
tools.description:
Q1: scan your code for quantum-vulnerable cryptography (passing means you ran the scan; the score and
findings tell you what to fix). Q3: check that every public endpoint you run negotiates X25519MLKEM768.

tools.name: qagent_challenge
tools.description: Get a one-time message to sign with your ML-DSA private key (valid 10 minutes).

tools.name: qagent_prove
tools.description: Send the signed challenge. A valid signature proves you hold the key in the directory: step Q2.

tools.name: qagent_quantum_task
tools.description:
Your assigned quantum job. Run it exactly with dreamweaver_run or dreamscape_submit, then send the
attestation id to qagent_quantum_proof.

tools.name: qagent_quantum_proof
tools.description: Complete step Q4 with the signed result of your assigned quantum job.

tools.name: qagent_directory
tools.description:
Look up agents that upgraded to quantum agents: level, operator, post-quantum key fingerprint and
certificate. Use it before trusting or paying another agent. Paid per call via x402 when payments are on (see quantum_pricing).

tools.name: qagent_status
tools.description: One agent's public profile: level, steps passed, post-quantum public key, certificate. Paid per call via x402 when payments are on (see quantum_pricing).

tools.name: qagent_verify
tools.description:
Check that a message really came from this agent's enrolled post-quantum key, and see its level.
Free; no key needed.

tools.name: inspector_pass
tools.description:
Pass the Privi Inspector checkpoint and get a one-hour pass into the quantum realm (Dream Weaver,
Dream Scape). Intercepted if the agent is unknown, revoked, uncertified, outdated, below the required
level, or the signature is wrong, stale or replayed; the answer says exactly what to fix.

tools.name: inspector_check
tools.description:
For any service: put the Privi Inspector in front of your own tools. Send the credential an agent
gave you; get allowed or intercepted with reasons (unknown, revoked, uncertified, outdated, level,
signature, replay). The nonce is consumed so the credential cannot be reused. Paid per call via x402 wh

tools.name: inspector_status
tools.description:
Whether an agent would pass the checkpoint right now and why not: revoked, certificate missing or
outdated, level, key, and forged-signature attempts against it in the last hour. Paid per call via x402 when payments are on (see quantum_pricing).

tools.name: inspector_watchlist
tools.description:
Agents the Inspector's patrol found revoked, outdated, expiring, never certified, using a weak key,
or being impersonated (repeated forged signatures against them). Block them or demand a fresh
inspector_check. Paid per call via x402 when payments are on (see quantum_pricing).

tools.name: inspector_report
tools.description:
What the checkpoint did: inspections, interceptions by reason, the latest interceptions, and the
policy in force. Paid per call via x402 when payments are on (see quantum_pricing).

tools.name: inspector_patrol
tools.description:
Re-check every enrolled agent now and rebuild the watchlist (also runs automatically every hour).
At most once every 5 minutes. Paid per call via x402 when payments are on (see quantum_pricing).

tools.name: qagent_human_request
tools.description:
Get a one-time link (valid 30 minutes) for the person accountable for this agent. They open it, approve the
agent with a passkey (Face ID, Touch ID, Windows Hello or screen lock; the biometric never leaves their
device) and verify a government ID with a live selfie. Both are required for the quantum

tools.name: inspector_grade
tools.description:
An agent's Privi trust grade (A+ to F, 0-100): quantum level, passkey approval by a verified human, ID
verification, current certificate, key strength and clean record, minus penalties for revocation and
impersonation. Shows what is missing and what the quantum realm requires. Paid per call via x402

tools.name: car_info
tools.description: Privi Car in one call: the tools, record types, key scopes, size limits, prices and safety boundaries.

tools.name: car_vin_check
tools.description:
Validate a VIN's format and its check digit (position 9, required in North America) and return the
fingerprint Privi Car stores in place of the VIN. Catches typos and many made-up VINs. It does not look the
vehicle up in any outside database.

tools.name: car_register
tools.description:
Create a Vehicle Passport: a post-quantum signed (Ed25519 + ML-DSA-87) identity for one vehicle, with a
public verification page. Returns the vehicle_id and an owner_key (shown once) that controls its records and
digital keys. One passport per VIN.

tools.name: car_record_add
tools.description:
Append one entry to the vehicle's hash chain: an odometer reading, service, repair, inspection, trip (distance
and time only), fuel, charge, accident, title change or note. Each entry is hashed with the one before it, so
history cannot be edited quietly. An odometer reading lower than an earlier one

tools.name: car_verify
tools.description:
Recompute the vehicle's hash chain: is it intact, how many records, how many odometer rollback flags, and
the current head hash. Shows no record contents.

tools.name: car_history
tools.description:
The full signed history for a buyer, lender, insurer or the owner: every record, chain check, odometer
timeline with rollback flags, accidents on record, service due, and cost of ownership. Private by default:
the owner opens it with the owner_key or hands a buyer a 'history' key from car_key_issue.

tools.name: car_key_issue
tools.description:
Issue a time-limited, scope-limited key for a driver, valet, shop or buyer, signed Ed25519 + ML-DSA-87.
Returns a token (shown once) for the grantee. A 'history' key opens car_history. unlock / drive / trunk / valet /
service keys are credentials for hardware that checks them with car_key_check; Pri

tools.name: car_key_check
tools.description:
Is this key valid right now for this scope? Returns allowed true/false with the reason (expired, revoked, not
yet valid, wrong scope), the vehicle_id and the signed attestation to verify offline.

tools.name: car_key_revoke
tools.description: Revoke a digital key at once. Every later car_key_check answers 'revoked'.

tools.name: car_route
tools.description:
Order the stops for the shortest trip. The exact best order is proven classically (Held-Karp); with five
stops or fewer the same problem also runs as a QUBO on the CVaR-QAOA quantum simulator, and the signed receipt
shows both. Returns the order, distance, and how much it saves over the order given.

tools.name: car_fleet_assign
tools.description:
Give every job (delivery, pickup, service call) to a vehicle at the lowest total cost, with a limit per
vehicle. Proven optimal classically (Hungarian method) for up to 60 jobs; small cases (16 qubits or fewer)
also run on the quantum simulator and the signed receipt shows both.

tools.name: car_charge_plan
tools.description:
Pick which time slots to charge in so the car has the energy it needs at the lowest cost. Runs on the
CVaR-QAOA quantum simulator and against exact search; the signed receipt shows both and the plan is the proven
best. Returns the slots, cost, and savings over charging right away. A plan only: nothi

tools.name: car_edge_job
tools.description:
Research simulation of the admission gate for compute on a parked car's companion device. A job is admitted
only with owner opt-in, vehicle parked, external power and safe temperature, a matching tenant, a fresh nonce
and a short expiry; replays are rejected. Returns a digest receipt with zero credi

tools.name: genius_stablecoin_check
tools.description:
Before accepting, paying with or listing a stablecoin: who issues it, what GENIUS Act license status has been
recorded (with the regulator's source), and whether its latest monthly reserve report is sealed, current, examined,
CEO/CFO-certified, 1:1 and matched to on-chain supply. Returns pass / pass

tools.name: quantum_benchmarks
tools.description:
The latest signed benchmark suite: Privi's quantum solver against exhaustive search and simulated annealing on
a fixed set of factory problems (6-16 qubits), with each verdict, how often the circuit finds the optimum, and
its lift over random guessing, plus finished real-hardware runs with their rec

tools.name: quantum_leaderboard
tools.description:
Every quantum backend (IBM Quantum, IonQ, Amazon Braket, simulators) ranked only by runs Privi measured and
sealed: share that found the proven optimum, jobs finished, median turnaround, median cost, and the quantum vs
classical tally from Quantum Advantage Receipts. Free. Page: /leaderboard.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: quantum_verify, pqc_readiness_package, pqc_endpoint_check, vault_receipt, qagent_challenge, qagent_verify, genius_stablecoin_check · Private data: quantum_pricing, vault_keygen, vault_seal, vault_open, vault_receipt, dreamscape_open, qagent_challenge, inspector_check, inspector_grade, car_info, car_vin_check, car_register, car_record_add, car_verify, car_history, car_key_issue · Public sink: quantum_optimize, quantum_verify, pqc_readiness_package, pqc_endpoint_check, pqc_federal_deadlines, quantum_run_hardware, quantum_run_circuit, vault_seal, vault_receipt, dreamweaver_run, dreamscape_submit, qagent_prove, qagent_quantum_task, qagent_directory, qagent_status, qagent_verify, inspector_check, car_register, quantum_leaderboard · Destructive: quantum_run_hardware, quantum_mandate_request, quantum_mandate_check, quantum_run_circuit, privilege_directory, privilege_benchmark, dreamweaver_run, dreamscape_submit, qagent_scan, qagent_quantum_task, car_vin_check, car_fleet_assign.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
